subject: Business Models
title: Dynamic Pricing
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on Dynamic Pricing.

hook.text: The same Uber ride costs $8 at noon and $32 during a rainstorm. The product hasn't changed.

buildup.text: Dynamic pricing adjusts prices in real time based on demand, supply, time, or customer data.

discovery.text: Airlines pioneered this. Two passengers on the same flight might pay $200 and $800 for the same seat.

twist.text: Amazon changes prices 2.5 million times per day. No human sets them—algorithms decide.

climax.text: Dynamic pricing maximizes revenue but erodes trust. Customers hate feeling gouged.

punchline.text: Same seat, different price. Algorithms decide what you pay.

quiz.question: How often does Amazon change prices?
